<p dir="auto">This project is available as a <strong>PyPI package</strong> for direct integration into your Python applications, or it can be run as a standalone API gateway. It provides:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>PyPI Library Integration</strong>: Easily import package modules like the client directly in your Python code.</li>
<li><strong>Interactive Swagger Playground</strong>: Access <code>/docs</code> for testing endpoints directly in the browser.</li>
<li><strong>Web API</strong>: Exposes endpoints for listing files and retrieving direct links.</li>
<li><strong>Unified Cloudflare Worker Proxy</strong>: Optimized TeraBox API access handling token resolution.</li>
<li><strong>Vercel-Ready Deployment</strong>: Ready-to-go serverless hosting configuration.</li>
<li><strong>Flexible Cookie Authentication</strong>: Simple string or JSON formatting for upstream auth.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">The API uses Flask 3.x native async support with <code>aiohttp</code> for asynchronous requests and leverages a unified Cloudflare Worker proxy with mode-based operations for efficient TeraBox API interaction.</p>
<hr>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h2><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Web API Endpoints</strong>:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>GET /docs</code>: Interactive Swagger UI documentation playground (API playground)</li>
<li><code>GET /swagger.json</code>: OpenAPI 3.0.0 schema specification</li>
<li><code>GET /api</code>: Unified endpoint - file listing with short links (resolve with <code>resolve=true</code>), and proxy modes (resolve, lookup, stream, page, api, segment, health)</li>
<li><code>GET /admin/*</code>: Path-based admin endpoints to inspect database records and analytics (overview, shares, files, thumbnails, kv/entry)</li>
<li><code>GET /health</code>: Simple health check endpoint</li>
<li><code>GET /</code>: API information and status</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Flexible Cookie Configuration</strong>:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Simple string format: Just paste your <code>ndus</code> token</li>
<li>Full JSON format: Supports multiple cookie fields</li>
<li>Environment variable or file-based configuration</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Rate Limiting</strong>:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Per-IP sliding-window rate limiter</li>
<li>Configurable limits via environment variables</li>
<li>Returns <code>429 Too Many Requests</code> with <code>Retry-After</code> header</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Response Caching</strong>:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>In-memory LRU cache with TTL expiration</li>
<li>Reduces redundant upstream requests on repeated lookups</li>
<li>Configurable TTL and max cache size</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Production Ready</strong>:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>CORS enabled for browser clients</li>
<li>Vercel deployment configuration included</li>
<li>Error handling with detailed logging</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Getting Your TeraBox Cookies</h2><a id="user-content-getting-your-terabox-cookies" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Getting Your TeraBox Cookies" href="#getting-your-terabox-cookies"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The API requires a valid <code>ndus</code> cookie to authenticate with TeraBox:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Log in to <a href="https://www.terabox.com" rel="nofollow">terabox.com</a> or <a href="https://1024terabox.com" rel="nofollow">1024terabox.com</a></li>
<li>Open your browser's Developer Tools (press <code>F12</code>)</li>
<li>Go to the <strong>Application</strong> or <strong>Storage</strong> tab</li>
<li>Navigate to <strong>Cookies</strong> → Select the TeraBox domain</li>
<li>Find the cookie named <code>ndus</code> and copy its <strong>Value</strong></li>
<li>Paste the value into your <code>.env</code> file as shown above</li>
</ol>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><code>GET /admin/*</code> - Admin Endpoints</h4><a id="user-content-get-admin---admin-endpoints" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: GET /admin/* - Admin Endpoints" href="#get-admin---admin-endpoints"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Path-based admin endpoints to inspect database records and analytics. All requests require authentication if configured in the worker. Pass the key using either <code>?key=YOUR_ADMIN_KEY</code> or <code>x-admin-key</code> header.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>GET /admin/overview</code>: Summary metrics of shares and files</li>
<li><code>GET /admin/shares</code>: Search and list resolved shares</li>
<li><code>GET /admin/files</code>: Search and filter media files</li>
<li><code>GET /admin/kv/entry?surl=...</code>: Lookup raw cached D1 share record</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Integration Examples</h2><a id="user-content-integration-examples" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Integration Examples" href="#integration-examples"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">You can easily query the gateway API using your preferred programming language. Here are examples of retrieving direct download links for a TeraBox share URL using the <code>/api</code> endpoint:</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🐍 Python (using <code>requests</code>)</h3><a id="user-content--python-using-requests" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🐍 Python (using requests)" href="#-python-using-requests"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">requests</span>

<span class="pl-k">def</span> <span class="pl-en">get_direct_links</span>(<span class="pl-s1">gateway_url</span>, <span class="pl-s1">share_url</span>):
    <span class="pl-s1">response</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">requests</span>.<span class="pl-c1">get</span>(
        <span class="pl-s">f"<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">{</span><span class="pl-s1">gateway_url</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>/api"</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">params</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>{<span class="pl-s">"url"</span>: <span class="pl-s1">share_url</span>}
    )
    <span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-s1">response</span>.<span class="pl-c1">status_code</span> <span class="pl-c1">==</span> <span class="pl-c1">200</span>:
        <span class="pl-s1">data</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">response</span>.<span class="pl-c1">json</span>()

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
)

type FileItem struct {
	Filename     string `json:"filename"`
	Size         string `json:"size"`
	DownloadLink string `json:"download_link"`
}

type APIResponse struct {
	Status string     `json:"status"`
	Files  []FileItem `json:"files"`
}

func getDirectLinks(gatewayURL, shareURL string) {
	resp, err := http.Get(fmt.Sprintf("%s/api?url=%s", gatewayURL, url.QueryEscape(shareURL)))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("Error:", err)
		return
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	var result APIResponse
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("Decode Error:", err)
		return
	}

	if result.Status == "success" {
		for _, file := range result.Files {
			fmt.Printf("File: %s\nSize: %s\nDirect Link: %s\n\n", file.Filename, file.Size, file.DownloadLink)
		}
	} else {
		fmt.Println("API returned an error status")
	}
}

func main() {

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Technical Implementation</h2><a id="user-content-technical-implementation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Technical Implementation" href="#technical-implementation"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Unified Proxy Architecture</h3><a id="user-content-unified-proxy-architecture" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Unified Proxy Architecture" href="#unified-proxy-architecture"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The TeraBox Gateway uses a <strong>unified Cloudflare Worker proxy</strong> for all TeraBox API interactions. This architecture provides:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Reduced Network Overhead</strong>: 33-50% fewer HTTP requests (1-2 instead of 2-3 per request)</li>
<li><strong>Server-Side Token Handling</strong>: Automatic jsToken extraction handled by the proxy</li>
<li><strong>Mode-Based Operations</strong>: Three distinct modes for different use cases</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Proxy Modes</h4><a id="user-content-proxy-modes" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Proxy Modes" href="#proxy-modes"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The unified proxy supports 5 distinct modes, all accessible via the <code>/proxy</code> endpoint:</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>1. <code>mode=resolve</code> (Recommended)</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Automatically fetches the share page, extracts jsToken, and returns file metadata</li>
<li><strong>Single HTTP call</strong> for most common use cases</li>
<li>Returns JSON with file list and metadata</li>
<li>Best for production use</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>2. <code>mode=page</code></strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Returns raw HTML of TeraBox share page</li>
<li>Useful for debugging and manual token extraction</li>
<li>Returns HTML content</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>3. <code>mode=api</code></strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Direct API access when jsToken is already known</li>
<li>Used for directory listings and advanced scenarios</li>
<li>Returns JSON from TeraBox API</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>4. <code>mode=stream</code></strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Fetches M3U8 playlist and rewrites segment URLs</li>
<li>Requires <code>surl</code> parameter (short URL ID)</li>
<li>Optional <code>type</code> parameter for quality selection (default: M3U8_AUTO_360)</li>
<li>Enables HLS video streaming in browsers and players</li>
<li>Returns modified M3U8 playlist</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>5. <code>mode=segment</code></strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Proxies individual video segments (.ts, .m4s files)</li>
<li>Automatically used by rewritten playlists</li>
<li>Returns binary media data</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Request Flow</h3><a id="user-content-request-flow" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Request Flow" href="#request-flow"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<p dir="auto"><strong>Key Benefits</strong>:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>✅ Simplified codebase with no manual token parsing</li>
<li>✅ Faster response times due to fewer roundtrips</li>
<li>✅ More reliable token extraction (handled server-side)</li>
<li>✅ Better error handling and reporting</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto"><strong>Error 400141 - Verification Required</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>The link is password-protected</li>
<li>Solution: Add <code>&pwd=PASSWORD</code> parameter to your request</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>HTTP 5xx Errors</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Your cookies may have expired</li>
<li>Solution: Update your <code>ndus</code> cookie following the steps above</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>No Direct Link Returned</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Cookies are invalid or expired</li>
<li>The share link itself has expired</li>
<li>Solution: Refresh cookies or verify the link is still active</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>"Cookies not loaded" Warning</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>.env</code> file is missing or <code>COOKIE_JSON</code> is not set</li>
<li>Solution: Create <code>.env</code> file and add your <code>ndus</code> token</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Authentication Failures</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>The <code>ndus</code> token is invalid or malformed</li>
<li>Solution: Copy the token again from your browser, ensuring no extra spaces</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Local DNS Connection Errors (e.g. <code>ClientConnectorDNSError</code> / <code>aiodns</code> failures)</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Occurs when running in restricted environments/sandboxes where python's <code>aiodns</code> is blocked from querying DNS servers directly.</li>
<li>Solution: The codebase automatically routes all connection requests using Python's native <code>ThreadedResolver</code> to utilize the host OS DNS configuration, which resolves this issue out of the box.</li>
</ul>
